name: Áed Dub
text: Áed Dub, dark fire in Irish, fulfilled the prophecy of the druid Bec mac Dé by killing Diarmait mac Cerbaill. MacKillop reads the form as the prophetic agent in the death of the high king. The principal record sits under Diarmait mac Cerbaill.

attributes.attribute: Dark-fire figure who killed Diarmait mac Cerbaill to fulfill Bec mac Dé's prophecy

okr.objective: Áed Dub is a MacKillop signpost to Diarmait mac Cerbaill.
key_results: Cites Diarmait mac Cerbaill as the canonical headword.
Killed the high king to fulfill Bec mac Dé's prophecy.
